provider_strata: Post-hoc total-variation cutoffs <=0.25, <=0.5, >0.5; future provider composition used for descriptive scoring only
spatial_graph: Per species: symmetrized 8-nearest-neighbour graph, great-circle distance <=100km; drop isolated cells; row standardize; at least30 connected cells
test: One-sided positive Moran autocorrelation; BH across tested species separately per model; residual-permutation diagnostic, not proof of absence of source bias
